cafe.set: A small sunny cafe interior seen from the front: a wooden counter with a silver coffee machine and a blank chalkboard-style panel on the back wall, a potted plant, warm cream walls with mint and coral accents, soft window light.
cafe.role_look: barista apron over the white shirt

frames.action: Carlos stands behind the counter with a welcoming smile and an open friendly mouth, one hand open toward Ama who steps up to the counter with a closed smile.
Ama points toward two tall glasses on a display shelf while Carlos listens with a closed smile and holds up a medium-sized cup in one hand.
Ama gestures at a carton of oat milk on the counter; Carlos nods with a friendly open mouth and slides a small plate of pastries toward her.
Ama shakes her head politely and lifts one palm; Carlos taps a blank card reader on the counter with a small open mouth.
Ama holds out a bank card toward the reader while Carlos's hand rests on the reader; two iced lattes sit ready beside them.

restaurant-order.set: A cosy evening restaurant interior: a small round table with white tablecloth next to a large window showing a dusk sky, warm hanging lamps, terracotta walls and green plants.
restaurant-order.role_look: waiter's dark apron over the white shirt, a folded cloth on one arm

frames.action: Carlos stands at the entrance with a welcoming gesture and open friendly mouth; Ama stands in front of him with a closed smile.
Ama points toward the window table and Carlos leads the way, holding two blank menus out to her.
Ama seated at the table, one finger tracing a picture icon in the open blank menu, while Carlos stands with a notepad with a blank page and a friendly look.
Ama leans slightly forward with an asking expression and a small open mouth; Carlos nods with a smile and holds an empty water jug.
Carlos places a glass of water and a bowl of soup on the table with a smile; Ama's hand makes a small writing-in-the-air gesture for the bill.

airport-checkin.set: A bright airport check-in hall: a long white desk with a luggage scale and short conveyor belt, big window with a plane outline outside, blue and white palette with orange accents, blank screens above the desk showing only simple plane icons.
airport-checkin.role_look: airline uniform vest in navy over the white shirt, no logo

frames.action: Ama wheels a suitcase up to the desk with a small open mouth; Carlos behind the desk greets her with a welcoming smile.
Carlos holds out his hand for the passport while Ama hands over her passport with one hand and holds her phone with the other.
Ama lifts her suitcase toward the luggage scale on the desk, Carlos watches and gestures toward the conveyor belt.
Close on the scale with the suitcase on it and a plain dial with no numbers; Carlos's hand points at the dial while Ama's hand rests on the suitcase handle.
Carlos shrugs gently with a sympathetic small open mouth and points to the suitcase as if suggesting taking items out; Ama looks thoughtful, hand on chin.

ask-directions.set: A sunny city street with pale pastel buildings on both sides, a crossing street on the right, and a big round clock tower on a station building far down the road, blue sky.

frames.action: Ama approaches Carlos on the pavement with a polite small open mouth, one hand raised; Carlos stands with a closed smile.
Carlos points straight ahead with an arm out; Ama tilts her head with a puzzled polite look, hand near her ear.
Carlos points straight ahead then to the right side street, Ama copies the right-turn gesture with her hand, both facing the junction.
Carlos points to the big clock on the station far away; Ama looks toward it with an asking expression.
Carlos waves cheerfully with an open mouth while Ama puts her hand on her chest with a grateful smile, ready to walk off.

train-station.set: A clean railway station ticket hall: a ticket window with glass and a counter, a view of a platform and a blue-and-white train through an archway, pale grey floor, teal and orange accents, a blank departure board showing only simple train icons.
train-station.role_look: station staff vest in teal over the white shirt, no logo

frames.action: Carlos sits behind the ticket window with a welcoming smile; Ama walks toward the window.
Ama leans toward the window gesturing a ticket shape with both hands; Carlos holds up two blank cards, one marked with a single arrow and one with a double arrow.
Ama glances at a blank wall clock while Carlos points through the archway to a train on a platform.
Ama traces a straight line on a simple route map made of dots; Carlos nods reassuringly and draws a straight line with his finger.
Carlos slides a printed blank ticket under the window glass toward Ama's hand, which holds a bank card.

taxi.set: Beside a yellow taxi on a sunny street: the car's front seat with a steering wheel and a small meter box with a blank screen, a kerb, and a tall station building in the background, warm yellow and sky-blue palette.
taxi.role_look: driver's flat cap and a light grey vest over the white shirt

frames.action: Carlos sits in the driver's seat of a yellow taxi with the window open, smiling; Ama stands at the kerb with a suitcase beside her.
Ama leans toward the open window pointing down the road; Carlos listens with a friendly open mouth.
Carlos gets out and lifts Ama's small suitcase into the boot; Ama stands beside him with a closed smile.
From the back seat, Ama points at the small meter box on the dashboard; Carlos nods, one hand on the wheel, glancing back with a smile.
Ama hands over a few coins while Carlos holds out his open palm; the taxi door is open and the station is behind them.

supermarket.set: A bright supermarket checkout area: a conveyor belt till with a card reader, shelves of colourful produce behind, a small customer service desk with a blank sign on the side, green and orange palette.
supermarket.role_look: cashier's green apron over the white shirt

frames.action: Carlos sits at the till smiling with an open friendly mouth; Ama stands at the belt with groceries in a basket.
Ama holds an open hand asking for a bag; Carlos reaches under the till and pulls out a paper shopping bag.
Ama takes a bank card from her wallet while Carlos points to the card reader on the till.
Ama holds a blank loyalty card with a star icon; Carlos points to the small customer service desk to the side.
Ama taps her card on the reader; Carlos hands her a filled shopping bag with a smile.

shop-return.set: A tidy clothing shop: a wooden counter with a till, racks of colourful clothes on the left, a mirror on the right wall, soft white and peach palette.
shop-return.role_look: shop assistant's open mid-grey apron over the shirt

frames.action: Ama holds a folded jacket toward Carlos at the counter with a small open mouth; Carlos gives a welcoming smile.
Ama pulls the jacket's zip to show it stuck halfway and holds the jacket against her body to show the fit, frowning slightly; Carlos looks concerned.
Ama hands over a small blank paper receipt while Carlos holds out his hand to take it.
Carlos shows two cards on the counter, one with a coin icon and one with a hanger icon; Ama points at the coin one with a satisfied look.
Carlos taps a card reader with the receipt beside it while Ama's bank card rests next to it.

tags.topic: returning an item in a shop

pharmacy.set: A calm pharmacy: a white counter, shelves of plain unlabelled boxes and bottles, a leafy plant, mint-green and white palette.
pharmacy.role_look: white pharmacist coat over the shirt

frames.action: Ama covers a cough with her fist near her mouth; Carlos stands at the counter in his white coat with a caring look.
Carlos gestures a questioning palm toward Ama's throat; Ama touches her chest with a tired expression and heavy eyelids.
Carlos holds a bottle of syrup and a measuring spoon; Ama holds a small box of tablets and looks questioning.
Ama's hand picks up the syrup bottle from the counter while Carlos gives a thumbs-up, and a coin purse waits next to it.
Carlos hands Ama a paper bag with the syrup and points to a calendar icon; Ama nods thankfully.

dentist.set: A clean dentist surgery: a reclining blue dental chair with a round light above, a small tray of instruments and a poster showing a plain tooth icon, pale blue and white palette.
dentist.role_look: white doctor coat over the blue blazer, surgical mask pulled down under the chin

frames.action: Carlos invites Ama to sit with a hand toward the dental chair; Ama sits down holding her cheek with a pained expression.
Ama points to a spot on the left of her cheek; Carlos leans in with a small hand mirror.
Carlos holds a cup of cold water and Ama winces holding her cheek with a hand raised.
Carlos shows Ama a large tooth model with a small dark hole and she looks concerned with her hand on her chin.
Carlos in gloves holds a small dental mirror and a numbing syringe on the tray while Ama has a closed trusting smile.

bank.set: A modern bank branch: a desk with a computer showing a blank blue screen with simple icons, two chairs, a plant, and a big window; navy and teal palette with warm accents.
bank.role_look: bank advisor's lanyard with a plain blank badge over the shirt

frames.action: Carlos sits at the desk and greets Ama with open arms; Ama walks to the chair opposite with a small open mouth.
Ama holds a book and notebook to show she is a student while Carlos listens with a smile.
Ama places a passport and a letter on the desk while Carlos holds out a hand.
Carlos holds up a blank bank card and Ama holds her phone showing a simple app icon.
Carlos taps on his computer and Ama's phone on the desk lights up with a plain keypad of dots.

job-interview.set: A bright modern office meeting room: a large wooden table with two chairs, a window with a city skyline, a plant in the corner, neutral white and soft blue palette.

frames.action: Carlos stands behind the table with an open hand inviting Ama to sit; Ama shakes his hand with a closed confident smile.
Carlos holds a folder and looks interested; Ama sits straight with open palms, explaining with a small open mouth.
Ama shows a simple bar-chart drawing on a sheet going downward, with no numbers or letters; Carlos looks impressed.
Carlos opens his palm inviting a question; Ama leans forward with a curious look and a raised hand.
Carlos stands and offers a handshake with a friendly open mouth while Ama accepts it with a warm smile, a bag over her arm.

office-intro.set: An open-plan office corridor with desks and laptops on the left, a small kitchen area with a kettle in the background, a staircase on the right, light grey walls with lime-green and orange accents.

frames.action: Carlos walks over to Ama's desk with a friendly wave and open mouth; Ama stands with her laptop bag and smiles.
Carlos and Ama shake hands with smiles; Ama points toward an unlabelled door along the corridor.
Carlos points up the staircase past the kitchen area; Ama follows his pointing with an interested look.
Ama holds a coffee cup toward Carlos with an inviting look; Carlos smiles and gives a thumbs-up.
Carlos opens his arms in welcome and Ama gives a small grateful nod with a closed smile, both beside the desk.

team-meeting.set: A bright meeting room: a long table with two laptops and a notebook, a wall-mounted blank whiteboard with simple coloured shapes, a window and a plant, white and blue palette.

frames.action: Carlos stands at the head of the table with an open mouth, hand toward the whiteboard; Ama sits at the table with a raised hand.
Carlos nods with a calm smile; Ama holds up a printed page with colourful pie-chart shapes.
Carlos looks at Ama with an interested face; Ama points to a happy face icon and a clock icon on the whiteboard.
Carlos spreads his hands asking a question; Ama draws a simple small booklet shape on the whiteboard with a marker.
Carlos nods approvingly with a thumbs-up; Ama writes in a notebook with a smile, near a calendar icon.

flat-viewing.set: A light, airy open-plan flat: a grey sofa, a double bed visible through an open door, a wardrobe, a small kitchenette, big windows, warm wood floor and soft pastel palette.

frames.action: Carlos opens the front door with a welcoming gesture; Ama steps in curiously looking around.
Carlos gestures toward the sofa, bed and wardrobe with a sweeping hand; Ama nods happily while looking at them.
Carlos holds a sheet with a coin icon and a house icon; Ama points to a water tap and a wi-fi icon with a questioning look.
Carlos holds a blank paper with a signature line; Ama looks over it thoughtfully with a hand on chin.
Carlos hands a pen to Ama over a blank contract on the table; Ama's hand takes it.

phone-plan.set: A modern phone shop: glass display counters with phones, a wall of colourful phone models, a counter with a tablet, bright white and purple palette.
phone-plan.role_look: phone shop staff polo under the blazer, plain without logo

frames.action: Carlos stands behind the counter greeting with a smile; Ama walks in holding her phone up.
Carlos asks with an open palm; Ama shows a video playing on her phone screen as a simple play icon.
Carlos points to a bold card showing an infinity symbol and a coin icon; Ama frowns slightly thinking.
Carlos shows a calendar card with a chain-link icon; Ama shakes her head slightly with a hand on her cheek.
Carlos holds up a smaller, cheaper plan card with a coin and a cloud icon; Ama holds her phone nearby with a thoughtful look.

lost-luggage.set: An airport baggage claim hall: an empty luggage carousel in the background, a lost-luggage desk with a blank screen, a big window with a plane outline, blue and orange palette.
lost-luggage.role_look: airport staff vest in navy over the shirt, no logo

frames.action: Ama stands at the empty carousel with open hands, looking puzzled, then Carlos waits at the lost-luggage desk with a smile.
Ama hands over a boarding pass and a small tag while Carlos takes them with a sympathetic look.
Ama shows a large rectangle shape with her hands; Carlos sketches a navy suitcase with a red ribbon on a sheet, no text.
Ama puts a hand on her chest with an urgent look and holds a small pill box; Carlos looks concerned.
Carlos holds a blank form and pen; Ama points to a small hotel-building icon on the form.

cinema-tickets.set: A cheerful cinema lobby: a ticket counter with a glass window, a blank poster wall showing only colourful shapes, a popcorn machine, deep red and gold palette.
cinema-tickets.role_look: cinema usher's red vest over the white shirt, no logo

frames.action: Carlos waits at the ticket window with a smile; Ama steps up with a bag and gives a small open-mouthed smile.
Carlos holds up a ticket pair; Ama points toward the back of the cinema through a door.
Carlos points to a simple seating-plan drawing with seats in rows; Ama gives an acceptable nod.
Carlos holds a card reader; Ama holds out her bank card and gestures for a receipt.
Carlos hands two cinema tickets and a receipt through the window to Ama's hand.

party-invite.set: A friendly neighbourhood park bench scene: green trees, a wooden bench, a blue sky, with a small floating balloon bunch tied to the bench, bright pastel palette.

frames.action: Ama sits on the bench holding a balloon string and smiling with an open mouth; Carlos sits near her with a closed smile.
Carlos leans in with an interested look; Ama holds up a blank party invitation card with a clock icon.
Carlos puts his hand on his heart with a grateful smile and gestures holding a snack basket, offering to bring something.
Ama waves her hands lightly in a no-need gesture and points toward a second friend-shaped icon; Carlos smiles.
Carlos and Ama give each other a friendly fist bump with big smiles.

tags.topic: inviting a friend to a party

post-office.set: A cheerful post office: a counter with a parcel scale and stamps, wall shelves of boxes and envelopes, a blank queue ticket machine, red and cream palette.
post-office.role_look: post office red vest over the white shirt, no logo

frames.action: Carlos waves at Ama from behind the counter; Ama approaches with a cardboard box in her arms.
Carlos looks at the box with curiosity; Ama opens the lid to show books and a folded scarf.
Carlos holds two cards, one with a plane icon and one with a ship icon; Ama points at the plane.
Carlos places the box on the parcel scale with a nod; Ama points at a tracking-barcode sticker with a curious look.
Carlos hands a printed blank receipt to Ama's hand with a stamp on it.
